steps.title: Your first visit
steps.text: Book a time and come along with whoever you would like to bring. We talk about the day, your budget and what you like, then you try on gowns in a private room. There is no obligation to order.

steps.title: Choosing and ordering
steps.text: When you have found the one, we confirm your size, take a deposit (amount TBC) and place the order with the maker. We will tell you the delivery date plainly, and what to allow if your date is close.

steps.title: Fittings and collection
steps.timing: Number of fittings and time between them: TBC
steps.text: Your gown is altered to fit you at fittings in the shop. When it is ready you collect it, or we arrange delivery. We recommend bringing the shoes and underwear you plan to wear.
